title: Contact Prime Acre Capital | Call, Text or Email
meta_description: Call, text or email Prime Acre Capital, or send your address for a no-obligation cash offer. What to have handy and what happens after you reach out.
h1: Talk to us about your house
lede: Call, text, email or use the chat. Or send the address with the form, and we'll call with a no-obligation cash offer, usually within 24 hours.

blocks.text: The chat in the corner of every page can answer common questions and help you set up a call. It's an AI assistant, and a person from our company reviews every request it sends us.
Only the address and a way to reach you are required. These help us give you a more precise number on the first call:

items: The condition of the house and any repairs it needs
Whether it's empty, lived in, or rented to tenants
Roughly what's owed on it: mortgage, liens or back taxes
The date you'd like to be done by

blocks.text: Please don't send Social Security, bank or loan account numbers. We never need them to make an offer.

sections.heading: What happens after you reach out

items: We look at the property, recent nearby sales and the repairs it likely needs.
We call with a cash offer, usually within 24 hours, and explain the numbers.
If you want to go ahead, we set up a short walkthrough in person or by video call, or you send a few photos.
You get a written agreement, and you choose the closing date.

blocks.text: There's no obligation at any point before you sign. If you want us to stop calling, texting or emailing, reply STOP to a text, tell us in the chat, or call or email, and we'll stop as soon as we can. [See every step in detail](how-it-works).

faqs.q: How soon will I hear back?
faqs.a: We usually call with an offer within 24 hours of getting the address. If you'd like a specific time, say so in the form or the chat.

faqs.q: Do I have to agree to text messages?
faqs.a: No. Texting is optional. Check the box only if you want texts. We'll still reach you by phone or email.
No. We don't sell your personal information. Our [privacy policy](privacy) explains what we collect and who we share it with.

faqs.q: Can I just ask a question without getting an offer?
faqs.a: Yes. Call, text, email or use the chat. There's no obligation to sell.
